method: Render 240x135 Eevee PNG, reload the saved PNG file inside Blender, sample pixel luminance/variance and publish the file.
truth_boundary: This proves a non-empty render signal for the accepted R15 scene/camera only. The signed image could not be visually inspected by this client, so composition, lighting, material quality, intersections/floating and GATE-ART remain unapproved.
